text: The classifying topos of a geometric theory T is a topos B[T] such that:
choices: B[T] has T as its internal language
geometric morphisms E → B[T] correspond naturally to T-models in E
B[T] is always a Grothendieck topos over T
the terminal object of B[T] is T
explanation: The classifying topos B[T] represents the functor Mod_T: Topos^op → Set. A geometric morphism f: E → B[T] is the same as a T-model in E. This 'classifies' all models of T.
